name: Notifies Topic
description: A CloudWatch alarm sends its state changes to an SNS topic (alarm -> topic): an SNS topic ARN among the alarm's alarm, OK or insufficient-data actions. The alarm's other actions (Lambda, Auto Scaling, Systems Manager) are not edges. A reference, not containment. Emitted whether or not the topic was collected: it resolves by deterministic identity (the topic ARN) when it is.
